label: Raman Spectroscopy Combined with Machine Learning Reveals Myalgic Encephalomyelitis-Associated Biomolecular Signatures at Rest and After Standardized Stress.
summary: Myalgic encephalomyelitis (ME) is characterized by profound fatigue, post-exertional malaise (PEM), and cognitive dysfunction. Despite its clinical significance, the pathophysiology of PEM and disease heterogeneity remain unclear, and no validated biomarkers are available for rapid diagnosis or monitoring.
